We are Teads

We don’t follow the digital landscape. We build  it.

Teads is the leading omnichannel outcomes platform for the open internet. Partnering with over 10,000 publishers and 20,000 advertisers worldwide, we connect with 2.2 billion people a
month. This means the code, campaigns, and strategies you ship directly touch a global audience at scale.

Headquartered in New York, with around 1700 talented individuals across 30+ countries, our team spans every continent and time zone, creating a dynamic environment where global
perspectives are not just welcomed — they’re essential to our success.

Working here means being part of a global conversation every day, where your local insights make a worldwide impact. World-class work, powered by people from dozens of nationalities —
in a culture that stays genuinely human.

A Career at Teads

Explore career opportunities and become part of a company that is transforming advertising on the open internet.

See Jobs

Why Work At Teads?

Reshaping Advertising

18 billion ad opportunities a day. Processing auctions in fractions of a second. Your scope is bigger than your title.

As the omnichannel outcomes platform, we're leading the charge to redefine what's possible.

Working at Teads means solving genuinely complex, real-time challenges to uncover smarter, more effective ways to deliver meaningful, measurable outcomes for brands, media owners, and consumers. Here, you won’t just manage tasks. You’ll own problems end to end.

Diversity with Purpose

We believe great ideas come from diverse perspectives—and we’re committed to creating an inclusive, equitable workplace where everyone belongs.

As a global company, we take our responsibility seriously because building a better company means helping build a better world.

Our four active communities - Women at Teads, Allies at Teads, Many Ways of Thinking, and Green at Teads - are integral to our business. They create space for learning, visibility, peer support, and local action, strengthening our culture and the way we work together.

A Truly Global Team

World-class work, powered by people from dozens of nationalities — in a culture that stays genuinely human.

Headquartered in New York, with around 1,700 talented individuals across 30+ countries, we're a company without borders. Our team spans every continent and time zone, creating a dynamic environment where global perspectives are not just welcomed — they're essential to our success.

Working here means being part of a global conversation every day, where your local insights make a worldwide impact.

Worklife Balance

We believe people do their best work when life and work are in harmony. With flexible hybrid schedules, remote work support, and a focus on well-being, we create space for you to thrive both personally and professionally.

Internal Mobility
& Career Growth

Your growth is our priority. We invest in your development through tailored career programs, internal mobility, and a global mentorship network. With our learning platform offering everything from product training to soft skills, we’ll support you in sharpening your expertise or exploring new paths.

Curious about what it's like to be part of the Teads team?

Stay connected and get an inside look into our culture, innovations, and daily life by following us on Instagram @teadsglobal.

Follow Us
